description:
We are Alice in Orbitland, a team of three passionate developers and technology enthusiasts participating in the NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026.

Our Team:

Harshita Gupta

Vicky Patel

Sara Naqvi

Together, we bring a shared interest in software development, space exploration, and solving real-world challenges through technology.

As a team, we aim to make complex lunar data easier to explore, understand, and use for informed mission-planning decisions.
